answer: The inlet chain is verified at intake and vertex publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 12 epochs old, anchored at a yarrow checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 12 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. That is 1115 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
